sumlatticeDiscinvle.name: Filling.sum_latticeDisc_inv_le
sumlatticeDiscinvle.statement:
lemma sum_latticeDisc_inv_le [StablyUnram E]
    [ok : S.IsAdmissible] s : ∑ c, ∑' T : {T : Submodule E _ // finrank E
  T + s = 𝔰.k}, ENNReal.ofReal (S.latticeDisc c T.1 ^ (𝔰.k + 1))⁻¹ ≤ .ofReal
  (card S.Classes / S.N ^ (𝔰.k * numInfPlaces E) * S.tailScale ^ (s + 1))

normsharedvectorlt.name: Filling.HasLevel.norm_shared_vector_lt
normsharedvectorlt.statement:
lemma HasLevel.norm_shared_vector_lt (h : S.IsNear γ ∧ S.HasLevel j γ) {u b Y} (U :
  u ∈ besselU0) (hb : ↑j ≤ b.1) (H : paddedLeading j (S.frameProducts γ) = Y) v a : 2 * ‖Φ v
  ((frameImage (u * γ).1.1 *ᵥ Y.det • Y⁻¹ᵀ b) (.inl a))‖ < S.levelPrime 0 ^ 𝔰.n ^ 4

tsuminvPowWeightleofcodimle.name: Filling.tsum_invPowWeight_le_of_codim_le
tsuminvPowWeightleofcodimle.statement:
lemma tsum_invPowWeight_le_of_codim_le [StablyUnram E]
    {t} s (h : A ⊆ {p | S.IsLabelledTerm j c t p}) T {n : _ → ℕ}
    (hQ : ∀ p ∈ A, S.frameValueIndex c (S.termElem c p) S.gIdele T ∣ n (S.termElem c p)) (hT : 𝔰.k ≤
  finrank E T + s) : ∑' p : A, S.invPowWeight c n p ≤
  .ofReal (S.b ^ (2000 * 𝔰.n ^ 6 * (s + 1) * numInfPlaces E))

submoduleIndexgIdelesmul.name: Filling.submoduleIndex_gIdele_smul
submoduleIndexgIdelesmul.statement:
lemma submoduleIndex_gIdele_smul {n} {M N : Submodule (Ô E) (n → 𝔸f E)} (h : 1 ≤ submoduleIndex N M)
  (i : N ≤ M) : submoduleIndex (S.gIdele • M) M = submoduleIndex (S.gIdele • N) N

sumpairWeightle.name: Filling.sum_pairWeight_le
sumpairWeightle.statement:
lemma sum_pairWeight_le : ∑ c, ∑ c', ∑' (γ) (γ'), S.pairWeight j c c' γ γ' ≤
  .ofReal (2 * S.tailScale ^ 2)

enormamplitudeSumleclassSizetop.name: Filling.enorm_amplitudeSum_le_classSize_top
enormamplitudeSumleclassSizetop.statement:
lemma enorm_amplitudeSum_le_classSize_top (hT : S.IsStable T) (h : ∀ γ ∈ T,
  S.termDisc γ ≠ 0) c s c' : ‖S.amplitudeSum T c s c'‖ₑ ≤ ∑' γ : ↥(T ∩ S.termsOver c s c'),
  ite (S.IsNearRep c c' γ) (.ofReal (S.unipCovolume * S.classSize ⊤ (S.termDiscNorm γ))) 0

enormamplitudeSumleclassSize.name: Filling.enorm_amplitudeSum_le_classSize
enormamplitudeSumleclassSize.statement:
lemma enorm_amplitudeSum_le_classSize (hT : S.IsStable T) {j} (h : ∀ γ ∈ T, S.HasLevel j γ) c s
  c' : ‖S.amplitudeSum T c s c'‖ₑ ≤ ∑' γ : {γ ∈ T ∩ S.termsOver c s c' | S.Agrees s ∧
  S.IsNearRep c c' γ}, .ofReal (S.unipCovolume * S.classSize j (S.classGauge j c c' γ))

amplitudeSumeqzeroofnotcharsAgree.name: Filling.amplitudeSum_eq_zero_of_not_charsAgree
amplitudeSumeqzeroofnotcharsAgree.statement:
lemma Filling.amplitudeSum_eq_zero_of_not_charsAgree [StablyUnram E]
    [S.IsAdmissible] [Side] {T} (hT :
  S.IsStable T) (h : ∀ γ ∈ T, ¬S.CharsAgree γ) c s c' : S.amplitudeSum T c s c' = 0

hasCommonFlagVectorofle.name: Filling.hasCommonFlagVector_of_le
hasCommonFlagVectorofle.statement:
lemma Filling.hasCommonFlagVector_of_le {γ} (hr : S.CharsAgree γ) a c c' (h : HasCommonFlagVector γ
  c c' a) : c * star c = c' * star c' ∧ ∀ b ≥ a, HasCommonFlagVector γ c c' b

existshasLevel.name: Filling.CharsAgree.exists_hasLevel
existshasLevel.statement:
lemma Filling.CharsAgree.exists_hasLevel {γ} (hr : S.CharsAgree γ) (h : S.termDisc γ = 0) : ∃ j,
  S.HasLevel j γ

energyleoflevelpairs.name: Filling.energy_le_of_level_pairs
energyleoflevelpairs.statement:
lemma Filling.energy_le_of_level_pairs j R (hc : ∀ γ ∈ T, S.HasLevel j γ) (h₂ : 𝔰.ϱ < j →
  (∃ Λ, Λ ∉ R) → S.tailScale ^ 12 / X ^
  𝔰.k * S.mainEnergy ≤ C) (h : linkEnergy T Ω R ≤ .ofReal (w * S.unipCovolume ^ 2)) : energy
  (S.amplitudeSum T) Ω ≤ w + C / S.b ^ 30 / 4 ^ j.rev.1

binders.type: (∃ γ ∈ T, ∃ c c', ∃ s ∈ Ω, γ ∈ S.termsOver c s c' ∧ IsNormalForm 0 γ) → S.tailScale ^ 20 * S.besselEnergy ≤ C

binders.type: 𝔰.ϱ < j → (∃ Λ, Λ ∉ R) → S.tailScale ^ 12 / X ^ 𝔰.k * S.mainEnergy ≤ C

energyleoflevellt.statement:

    energy (S.amplitudeSum T) Ω ≤ C / S.b ^ 30 / 4 ^ n.rev.1

binders.type: (∃ γ ∈ T, ∃ c c', ∃ s ∈ Ω, γ ∈ S.termsOver c s c' ∧ IsNormalForm 0 γ) → S.tailScale ^ 20 * S.besselEnergy ≤ C

binders.type: ∀ γ ∈ T, S.CharsAgree γ → ∃ j < n, S.HasLevel j γ

energyleoflinkEnergyle.name: Filling.energy_le_of_linkEnergy_le
energyleoflinkEnergyle.statement:
lemma Filling.energy_le_of_linkEnergy_le R (h₂ : (∃ Λ, Λ ∉ R) →
  S.tailScale ^ 12 / X ^ 𝔰.k * S.mainEnergy ≤ C)
  (h : linkEnergy (T ∩ {γ | S.termDisc γ ≠ 0}) Ω R ≤ .ofReal (w * S.unipCovolume ^ 2)) :
  energy (S.amplitudeSum (σ := .full) T) Ω ≤ (1 + (S.b ^ 4)⁻¹) ^ 2 * w + (S.b ^ 12)⁻¹ * C

energy.name: Filling.energy
energy.statement: noncomputable def energy := ∑ c, ∑ c', ∑ s with s ∈ Ω, ‖A c s c'‖ ^ 2 / S.unipCovolume ^ 2

linkEnergy.name: Filling.linkEnergy
linkEnergy.statement:
noncomputable def linkEnergy [Side] (R : Set _) := ∑' (c) (c') (s : Ω') (Λ :
  R), ‖S.amplitudeSum (T ∩ link ⁻¹' {Λ.1}) c s.1 c'‖ₑ ^ 2

amplitudeSumsplit.name: Filling.amplitudeSum_split
amplitudeSumsplit.statement:
lemma amplitudeSum_split [Side] : S.amplitudeSum T = S.amplitudeSum (T ∩ Uᶜ) + S.amplitudeSum
  (T ∩ U)

energyaddle.name: Filling.energy_add_le
energyaddle.statement:
lemma energy_add_le (hε : 0 < ε) : energy (A + B) Ω ≤
  (1 + ε) * energy A Ω + (1 + ε⁻¹) * energy B Ω

energysubcutle.name: Filling.energy_sub_cut_le
energysubcutle.statement:
lemma energy_sub_cut_le : energy (S.amplitudeSum U - S.amplitudeSum (σ := .cut) U) Ω ≤
  (S.b ^ 30)⁻¹ * S.besselEnergy

classSize.name: Filling.classSize
classSize.statement:
noncomputable def classSize (j : Fin (𝔰.ϱ + 2)) x := S.tailScale ^ 2 * √(ite (𝔰.ϱ < j) S.mainEnergy
  (S.tailScale ^ 13 / (S.tailScale ^ 32) ^ j.1 * S.besselEnergy) /
  (S.countWeight 0 * S.g ^ (2 * min 𝔰.ϱ j * 𝔰.k * numInfPlaces E) * x ^ (𝔰.k + 1)))

leclassSizeandcellMassle.name: Filling.IsNear.le_classSize_and_cellMass_le
leclassSizeandcellMassle.statement:
lemma IsNear.le_classSize_and_cellMass_le {S : Filling E 𝔰} {γ} [ok : S.IsAdmissible] (n :
  S.IsNear γ) (N : 1 ≤ S.termDiscNorm γ) : (S.b ^ (𝔰.k ^ 3 * numInfPlaces E))⁻¹ ≤ S.classSize ⊤
  (S.termDiscNorm γ) ∧ ∏ v, cellMass (S.ratToInf γ v) (S.besselSys v).deg S.boxSize (Fintype.card
  (S.besselSys v).I) ≤ (S.unipCovolume * S.classSize ⊤ (S.termDiscNorm γ) / 2) ^ 2

schurWeight.name: Filling.schurWeight
schurWeight.statement:
noncomputable def schurWeight y := S.boxCutoff c ((S.ratToInf γ)⁻¹ * y) * ∏ v, .ofReal
    ((frameVolume (y v) / frameVolume (((S.ratToInf γ)⁻¹ * y) v)) ^ (𝔰.k + 𝔰.n))

schurIntegral.name: Filling.schurIntegral
schurIntegral.statement:
noncomputable def schurIntegral := ∫⁻ y,
  S.boxCutoff c y * (∏ v, ‖(S.besselSys v).W .cut (y v)‖ₑ ^ 2) * S.schurWeight c' γ' y

inCutofbesselKernelnezero.name: Filling.inCut_of_besselKernel_ne_zero
inCutofbesselKernelnezero.statement:
lemma inCut_of_besselKernel_ne_zero {y} (h : S.besselKernel γ y ≠ 0) v : InCut (y v) S.b ∧
  InCut (((S.ratToInf γ)⁻¹ * y) v)
  S.b

amplitudeAbssqle.name: Filling.amplitudeAbs_sq_le
amplitudeAbssqle.statement:
lemma amplitudeAbs_sq_le [S.IsAdmissible] : S.amplitudeAbs c c' γ ^ 2 ≤
  S.schurIntegral c c' γ * S.schurIntegral c' c γ⁻¹

lintegralboxCutoffleofaverage.name: Filling.lintegral_boxCutoff_le_of_average
lintegralboxCutoffleofaverage.statement:
lemma lintegral_boxCutoff_le_of_average [S.IsAdmissible] c (m : Measure X) [SFinite m] {s : X → _ →
  _} (ms : Measurable s) (hs : ∀ x v, s x v ∈ besselU0) {F} (mF : Measurable F) (hF :
  ∀ u ∈ S.classUnip₀ c, ∀ y, F (S.ratToInf u * y) = F y) B (hm : 1 ≤ m
  B) {C} (h : ∀ u, (∀ v, u v ∈ besselU0) → ∀ y ∈ S.boxedPoints, ∫⁻ x in B, F (u * s x * y) ∂m ≤
  C) : ∫⁻ y, S.boxCutoff c y * (∏ v, ‖(S.besselSys v).W .cut (y v)‖ₑ ^ 2) * F y ≤
  C * (.ofReal S.unipCovolume * Fintype.card S.BesselCoord)

binders.name: hs
binders.type: ∀ x v, s x v ∈ besselU0

binders.name: hF
binders.type: ∀ u ∈ S.classUnip₀ c, ∀ y, F (S.ratToInf u * y) = F y

binders.name: h
binders.type: ∀ u, (∀ v, u v ∈ besselU0) → ∀ y ∈ S.boxedPoints, ∫⁻ x in B, F (u * s x * y) ∂m ≤ C

termsofclassspec.name: Filling.terms_of_class_spec
termsofclassspec.statement:
lemma Filling.terms_of_class_spec δ (m : δ ∈ doubleCoset γ (S.classUnip₀ c) (S.classUnip₀ c')) :
    S.HasLevel j δ ∧ S.frameProducts δ = S.frameProducts γ ∧ δ ∈ S.termsOver c s c' ∧ ∀ i,
  (frameMiddle (S.termPosition c c' δ) - frameMiddle (S.termPosition c c' γ))ᴴ.col
  i ∈ S.gIdele • colLattice (Ô E) (xRows ((S.latMiddle _).frameGram (S.termPosition c c' γ)))ᴴ

tsumschurIntegralle.name: Filling.tsum_schurIntegral_le
tsumschurIntegralle.statement:
lemma Filling.tsum_schurIntegral_le : ∑' δ : doubleCoset γ (S.classUnip₀ c) (S.classUnip₀ c'),
  S.schurIntegral c c' δ ≤ .ofReal (S.unipCovolume * (card S.BesselCoord * S.tailScale ^ 2 *
  (S.b ^ 4 * S.g)⁻¹ ^ (min 𝔰.ϱ j * 𝔰.k * numInfPlaces E) * (S.xRowsIndex j (S.termPosition c c'
  γ) / √(S.minorNorm j γ)) ^ (𝔰.k + 1)))

tsumamplitudeAbsclassle.name: Filling.tsum_amplitudeAbs_class_le
tsumamplitudeAbsclassle.statement:
lemma Filling.tsum_amplitudeAbs_class_le (k : S.termDiscNorm γ ≤ S.N ^ numInfPlaces E * S.minorNorm
  j γ) : ∑' δ : doubleCoset γ (S.classUnip₀ c) (S.classUnip₀ c'), S.amplitudeAbs c c' δ ≤
  .ofReal (S.unipCovolume * S.classSize j (S.classGauge j c c' γ))

binders.name: k
binders.type: S.termDiscNorm γ ≤ S.N ^ numInfPlaces E * S.minorNorm j γ
